title: The Apocalypse is Neigh!
author: logicanimal
rules:
Rules:

1. Place digits 1–9 so that no digits repeat in any row/column/region.

2. The four Apocalyptic horses (digits 1-4) are very territorial. No two horses may be at a knight’s move from each other.

3. Each horse has a corresponding horseman (digits 5–8), where together their digits sum to 9. Each horse must be orthogonally adjacent to its horseman, but not every horseman needs to be adjacent to its horse. Equivalently every digit x≤4 must be adjacent to at least one digit 9-x.

4. The digits in each dotted cage must sum to one of the following: 10/31/26.

You can solve the puzzle here.

This is one of several puzzles I made this year with varying styles/difficulties themed around horses and 2026.

Enjoy!
solutionCode: Enter the digits in row 2 and 6.
